card.label: H.J.Res. 106
card.summary: H.J. Res. 106 is a joint resolution that disapproves and nullifies a specific rule issued by the Bureau of Land Management on November 12, 2024. The rule in question is the Central Yukon Record of Decision and Approved Resource Management Plan in Alaska, which had modified prior land management plans and designated about 3,611,000 acres as areas of critical environmental concern or research natural areas. Because of this resolution, the rule has no force or effect.
